name: Evidentia drafting assistant — Northwind website
capability: Evidence-grounded drafting of website content from approved knowledge; GEO readiness analysis; AI visibility measurement
purpose: Help the communications team produce accurate, citable website content about Northwind Bank's services, reviewed and approved by a named editor before publication.
riskReasoning: Annex III screening: the system does not perform biometric identification, critical-infrastructure control, education/vocational scoring, employment decisions, access to essential services, law enforcement, migration, or justice/democratic-process functions. It drafts corporate web content under human editorial control. Limited-risk transparency obligations (Art. 50) apply to published AI-assisted text.
humanOversight: Every AI-assisted draft passes deterministic evidence verification and a policy gate, then requires approval by a second named person (four-eyes). Published pages carry a visible AI transparency notice and a signed machine-readable manifest naming the accountable editor.
approvedUses: Drafting service explanations, FAQs and press-derived summaries from approved sources
Readiness analysis of Northwind web pages
Measuring brand visibility in AI answer engines through official APIs
prohibitedUses: Content about individual customers or employees
Financial advice or product recommendations to consumers
Health, safety or investment claims without legal review

evidence.label: AI literacy briefing for the communications team (Art. 4)
